description: What to run in a project-wide suite run.

check_ids.description: Ids of the checks to run. Omit to run every enabled check in the project.

subject_type.description:
Narrow the run to one subject. Pass subject_uuid with it. Ignored when check_ids is given.

* `table` - table
* `view` - view
* `metric` - metric
* `posthog_table` - posthog_table

subject_uuid.description: Id of the subject to run every enabled check on. Pass subject_type with it.
